caption: Anti-Islamic writings and neo-Nazi symbols found on San Diego mosque shooters’ car & weapons.
Investigators say anti-Islamic writings, racist messages, and neo-Nazi symbols were discovered on the suspects’ vehicle and weapons following the deadly shooting at the Islamic Center of San Diego.

According to authorities, the two teenage suspects allegedly covered parts of their car and firearms with extremist symbols and anti-Muslim messages before carrying out the attack that killed three worshippers. Officials are now treating the shooting as a likely act of domestic extremism and hate-motivated violence.
Law enforcement sources also reportedly found writings praising neo-Nazi ideology and material linked to anti-Islamic extremist beliefs during the investigation.

The attack has sparked outrage across the United States, with religious leaders and civil rights groups calling for stronger action against violent extremism and hate crimes targeting places of worship.
